[[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] '''Caleb Hctaqsas''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Defel/Legends|Defel]] who joined the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He was the father of [[Lieutenant Commander/Legends|Lieutenant-Commander]] [[Sasnak Toxis]].
